title: Hom continuity for the recorded original-counit comparisons
statement: Let $I$ be a preordered set directed under $\leq$, let $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ be a diagram, and let $(A,c)$ be a colimit cocone. Fix $i\in I$, a scheme $X$, and a locally finitely presented, quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism $s:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$. Assume the shared derived-category instances [def-pc-derived-category] for every scheme and for the module categories over every open of $X$. Let $P,Q\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ be perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]. For $j\geq i$ put $X_j=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ and $X_A=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(A)$, with projections $p_j,p_A$ to $X$, and put $P_j=Lp_j^*P$, $Q_j=Lp_j^*Q$, $P_A=Lp_A^*P$, $Q_A=Lp_A^*Q$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Use the original-counit conjugated stage maps $M_{jk}$ and limit maps $M_{jA}$ [lem-pc-recorded-perfect-hom-transport]. For every $j_0\geq i$ and $\varphi:P_A\to Q_A$ there are $j\geq j_0$ and $a:P_j\to Q_j$ with $M_{jA}(a)=\varphi$. For every $j\geq i$ and $a,b:P_j\to Q_j$ with $M_{jA}(a)=M_{jA}(b)$ there is $k\geq j$ such that $M_{jl}(a)=M_{jl}(b)$ for every $l\geq k$.

proof.text: Use the normalization automorphisms. Conjugate the limit morphism by the inverse automorphism at its source and the forward automorphism at its target. Apply the existing cofinal-tail continuity theorem and conjugate the stage lift in the opposite direction. The normalization equation and cancellation prove the desired limit image.
